newsitem.title: USA: GTE signs $5 mln Korean Telecom contract.
newsitem.headline: GTE signs $5 mln Korean Telecom contract.

text.p: GTE Corp said Monday its data services unit has signed a $5 million contract with Samsung Data Systems to provide communications and information systems consulting for Korea Telecom.
GTE said it and Samsung Data Systems will work together in creating a customer information system for Korea Telecom.

GTE Data Services has provided telephone billing systems and consulting to companies in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Canada, the Netherlands, Denmark and Venezuela. This contract is the first for the unit in the Far East, the company said.
